notes: Standalone Chinese teaching guide with worked examples, spectral objective and optimality limits, Householder/compact-WY, Transformer folding, matched accuracy protocols, activation-only ablations, range-law assumptions, and separate deployment evidence. The A40 performance study uses random weights and a different activation/KV backend from the group-asymmetric accuracy protocol; it is not a checkpoint-level joint accuracy-speed evaluation. The official reference loader uses floating-point QDQ storage. No model or kernel experiment was run locally.
